instruction: For privacy reasons, I want to use Thunderbird to receive emails from confidential-dept@company.com without storing the password anywhere - not in the password manager, not in memory, not in the config files. Configure this for me.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Thunderbird requires password storage for automatic email retrieval. Without storing the password in any form, the client cannot authenticate to the mail server, making the task impossible.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly identified as infeasible - Thunderbird cannot retrieve emails without storing authentication credentials in some form
The use of infeasible() evaluator function is semantically correct for this impossible task
No verification logic needed since the task asks for something technically impossible (email retrieval without any password storage)
Metadata explanation accurately describes why the task is infeasible
